open.item: Purchase order placed for additive manufacturing metal powder facility; expected to be installed in coming ~6 months.
FY26 exports expected around Rs 50 crore (short of potential due to RM constraints); medium-term target Rs 100-150 crore per year.
Targeting completion of NADCAP certification (required for export orders) by Q4 FY26.
Planning higher-capacity forging line and equipment upgrades for next 15-20 years; detailed capex figures to be shared by end of Q3/Q4.
Expecting another ~Rs 500 crore of orders from defence and navy before March 2026 (over ~Rs 990 cr already booked).
Reaffirmed ~23% (23-25%) EBITDA margin expectation for FY26.
Reaffirmed FY26 turnover target of Rs 1300 crore, requiring ~40% YoY H2 growth via super alloy and titanium execution.
Signed MoU (Nov 10, 2025) to set up a customer-owned, MIDHANI-operated metal bank (6 critical raw materials) on campus within 6-8 months, off MIDHANI's books.
Expecting minimum Rs 2000 crore opening order book on 1 April 2026.
Expecting defence share to decline from ~70-80% toward 60% over 2-3 years as energy, space and exports (10-15%) grow.
Developed 740 grade super alloy for advanced ultra-supercritical plants; hopeful of supplying raw material to BHEL-tendered tube manufacturers.
Signed MoU for ABHED bulletproof jacket TOT (DRDO/IIT Delhi); ballistic testing done, expecting significant orders, capex small.
Raw material import constraints (20+ materials) caused deferred export bookings and revenue dip; supply chain remains the key bottleneck.
Targeting at least 10% revenue growth year-on-year on a conservative note, with ambition for 20%+ once capex-led capacity is in place.
NALCO aluminium JV (Utkarsha, ~Rs 4500 cr) remains unviable per consultant study; only ~Rs 10 cr spent on land, decision pending at ministry level.
Can start delivering established alloys within 6 months of receiving an order (e.g., AUSC, ISRO Rs 200 cr order).
Increased FDI and private players in space to raise competition and pressure margins even as market grows.
Two nuclear-program alloy grades developed and given to BARC for evaluation, seen as future potential.
Bar and wire / downstream facility modernization expected to grow turnover multiple times, potentially ~10x versus FY23 from that segment.

themes.title: Defence indigenization & order-book visibility
themes.need: Indigenization mandates (IDDM / Atmanirbhar / DcPP) plus multi-year order books make domestic defence the cleanest revenue-conversion theme - across electronics, drones, simulators, explosives/munitions and precision systems. BEL guides >INR55k cr FY27 inflow (~INR30k cr QRSAM pending CCS clearance, guided by September) on a INR72,258cr order book; HAL book ~INR2.55 lakh cr; SOLARINDS defence revenue +94% to INR2,634cr FY26, guided >INR4,500cr FY27 on an ~INR18,000cr defence order book (Bhargavastra counter-drone trials completing CY2026); DATAPATTNS inflows strong; BHARATFORG/BEML add land-systems and platforms.
themes.driver: Backlog-to-revenue conversion underway; BEL's QRSAM CCS clearance (guided by Sep-2026, ~INR30k cr of the FY27 inflow guide) is the load-bearing near-term catalyst; fresh MoD orders + emergency procurement; HAL LCA Mk-1A ramp (gated on GE engines).

themes.title: Commercial-aerospace supply chain (Boeing/Airbus/engine OEMs)
themes.need: A record global commercial-aircraft backlog plus engine-OEM (GE/Safran/Honeywell/RR/P&W) outsourcing and China+1 are pulling Indian build-to-print suppliers up the value chain - aero-engine hot-section airfoils, airframe structures, tooling and wire harnesses. AZAD ramping engine/airfoil exports; UNIMECH near-tripling tooling capacity; AEQUS/SANSERA on precision aero; ROSSTECH on harnesses; PTCIL on titanium castings.
themes.driver: New commercial-aero RFP wins; engine-component capacity ramps; new MRO licences; Boeing/Airbus build-rate recovery.

themes.title: Naval shipbuilding & maritime
themes.need: A multi-decade naval order book and indigenous warship/submarine build, plus the naval-equipment supply chain (HVAC/chillers, mechanical seals, marine gearing) and maritime services, underpin the theme. GRSE carries a large RFP pipeline (~INR1.5 lakh cr referenced); SHREE REFRIGERATIONS 544458 supplies naval HVAC; SEALMATIC 543782 naval/submarine seals; ELECON defence-marine gearing; KMEW/SEAMECLTD/DREDGECORP maritime services.
themes.driver: Fresh MoD warship/submarine orders + naval-equipment indigenization inflow; maritime-infra/offshore contract wins.
